Call syntax

DataFrame.to_xml(
    path_or_buffer=None,
    *,
    index=True,
    root_name='data',
    row_name='row',
    na_rep=None,
    attr_cols=None,
    elem_cols=None,
    namespaces=None,
    prefix=None,
    encoding='utf-8',
    xml_declaration=True,
    pretty_print=True,
    parser='lxml',
    stylesheet=None,
    compression='infer',
    storage_options=None,
)
